content: The broader shipping sector has also experienced its own volatility; a June 2026 market update by Maersk highlighted surges in demand coinciding with early peak-season shipping and significant fluctuations in spot rates, reflecting persistent price volatility in key trade lanes that indirectly affect vehicle import and export logistics in South Africa [33] . At that time, these companies facilitated domestic vehicle transfers with transport durations typically varying between 3 to 7 days, and service costs ranging from R4000 to R7000 depending on the route and service level . Although this historical pricing and operational data pertains to 2022 and requires careful validation against 2026 market conditions, it underscores the operational framework of the domestic sector [35] . The market also features highly specialized niche operators, such as those focusing exclusively on the transportation of luxury vehicles and supercars between major economic hubs like Durban and Johannesburg [33] . Additionally, international vehicle transport services, such as those provided by IVSS UK, continue to facilitate the movement of vehicles from South Africa to Europe utilizing Roll-on/Roll-off (RoRo) and container shipping methods [34] . Historical pricing benchmarks for containerized transport point to costs ranging from 3,700 to 4,200 USD, though these figures serve primarily as general operational baselines rather than definitive current pricing for 2026 [33] . Transport companies in South Africa cater to these corporate clients by prioritizing speed, reliability, and cost-effective cargo transport solutions. Automotive dealerships further support this corporate demand by providing streamlined access to commercial fleets, utilizing digital platforms that allow logistics and delivery-focused clients to efficiently manage their vehicle acquisitions [42] [33] . In sharp contrast to the commercial sector, the transport of Luxury and Exotic Cars serves a highly specialized and distinct client profile. Within this niche market, private individuals constitute the majority, accounting for 60.0 percent of the client base, which represents their maximum market share across all vehicle categories. Corporate and dealership involvement in the luxury and exotic segment is correspondingly lower, sitting at 40.0 percent.
